module: Module 2: What This Means for You
title: Interaction: Starting a Pay Conversation

Statement_01.text: Select each card to reveal a conversation starter you can use.

narration.text: If you want to have a pay conversation with your manager, here are four ways to get started. Select each card to reveal a conversation starter you can use.

visual_notes: Four click-to-reveal cards: Your Positioning / Your Factors / Progression Path / Career & Compensation.

cards.label: Your Positioning
cards.reveal_text: Can you help me understand where I fall within my pay range?

cards.label: Your Factors
cards.reveal_text: What factors are currently shaping my position in the range?

cards.label: Progression Path
cards.reveal_text: What development or performance would support progression over time?

cards.label: Career & Compensation
cards.reveal_text: How should I think about future career growth and compensation together?
